experiment: YY joint small-noise population order check on the frozen E7 corrugated torus

corrugated_torus_r3.label: Corrugated torus subset R^3
corrugated_torus_r3.query_rule: rotational symmetry fixes u=0; equal-area v mid-quantiles; preliminary point x(v)+sigma*n(v)
corrugated_torus_r3.latent_rule: tensor midpoint rule in u and equal-area v quantiles

population_integration.noise_reduction: Gaussian noise integrated analytically into noncentral-chi radial and one-dimensional Gaussian longitudinal moments
population_integration.tail_bound_description: latent components more than 12 sigma beyond compact observed-space support are omitted; omitted Gaussian tails are at the exp(-72) scale before dimension-polynomial factors

failure_policy: retain every declared cell and query; never crop sigma points, query locations, or slope windows
